gloss: going up and down; ascent and descent; both directions (trains)

definitions.gloss: going up and down; ascent and descent
definitions.explanation: The physical act of going uphill and downhill, or ascending and descending. Used for slopes, stairs, and roads.

definitions.gloss: up and down trains; both directions (of a line)
definitions.explanation: On a railway, trains running toward the line's central terminus ({上|のぼ}り, such as toward Tokyo) and away from it ({下|くだ}り), or both directions together. Heard constantly in station announcements.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This road has many ups and downs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: Just going up and down the stairs leaves me out of breath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: After repeatedly going up and down mountain paths, we finally reached the summit.

examples.japanese: {上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせている→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧。
examples.english: Service is suspended in both directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すれ{違|ちが}う→すれ違う：02122_surechigau⟧。
examples.english: The up and down trains pass each other at this station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両方向|りょうほうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the accident, trains are running late in both directions.

notes:
USAGE:
{上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り describes going up and down terrain, stairs, or slopes, and on the railways the two directions of a line. For rises and falls in prices or temperatures, use {上|あ}がり{下|さ}がり; for the ups and downs of life, ⟦{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み→浮き沈み：09611_ukishizumi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (has many ups and downs)
- {上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (in both directions, of trains)
- {上|のぼ}り{下|くだ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to repeatedly go up and down)
